description: The figure is a donut-style pie chart representing the distribution of entity topics in the dataset, showing 5 slices total. The slices are labeled (via a central legend titled “Topics”) as Moive in light blue at about 41.2%, Person in light pink at about 30.5%, Common in light green at about 14.9%, Book in pale yellow at about 9.1%, and Sport in light purple at about 4.3%. Percentage values are printed on or near each slice, and the chart includes the legend inside the donut hole; no slice appears exploded or otherwise visually emphasized, and the slices appear arranged roughly from the largest segment (Moive) through smaller segments around the ring.
